palette: 宣纸底 + 栗木框 + 乌木珠 + 黄铜珠 + 朱红档线 + 靛蓝
typography: heavy woodblock headings, rounded bead chips, counter-style label blocks, double-frame verdict seals
composition: an abacus counter splits each scene into surface and depth: beads above the beam are visible objects, beads below the beam are protected interests; doctrine rooms and charter steles flank the frame
surface: paper grain, wooden beam bands, pill-shaped bead chips, round-dash review routes, double-frame seals; no glossy panels
motion: facts push beads into rows, routes fork into doctrine rooms, seals land as verdicts; no idle loops
transition: the wooden beam persists as the surface/depth boundary across scenes
